note: Input to the fix-generation stage. The 'reason' field intentionally states only WHY the site was flagged, never the replacement text -- giving the fix-generation agent the answer in its own input would make the experiment circular. Fix-generation's job is to read the migration spec and the actual source and determine the correct edit itself.
